duration: 2-hour weekly shift for a minimum of 6 months
notes: Book Buddies (K to 6th grade, all ages welcome with an adult) needs no application. Shelter hours for Book Buddies are listed on the page.
name: Volunteering at the Bloomington Animal Shelter
org: City of Bloomington Animal Care and Control
what_you_do: Help care for shelter animals with a weekly 2-hour shift for at least 6 months. Younger kids can join Book Buddies and read aloud to shelter animals with an adult.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 15 must be with a legal guardian at all times. Ages 16 and older can volunteer on their own. Everyone must pass screening.
deadline_text: The page (updated September 24, 2026) says the waitlist is open. You join the waitlist now and get the application link later.
how_to_apply: Join the waitlist through the Bloomington Volunteer Network. Use the green button on the page. That is not the application. The volunteer director will email you a link to it later.
